sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: Vision, fatigue, health and emotional fitness
Every knowledge statement for Vision, fatigue, health and emotional fitness is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
Vision statements retain the exact acuity figures, correction option and daylight restriction without inventing a complete eligibility algorithm. Rest guidance is not a guarantee that a brief break or a drink restores fitness.
Diagnosis-specific medical advice, medication-changing language and unsupported statistical comparisons are withheld. No clinical clearance or current legal eligibility determination is made by this authoring pass.
Open source limitation (verify DE-FITNESS-CLINICAL): The health subsection gives broad statements about epilepsy, insulin-treated diabetes, cardiovascular conditions and loss-of-consciousness certification. Diagnosis-specific advice and the certification scope are withheld pending qualified clinical/legal review.
Open source limitation (verify DE-FITNESS-MEDICATION): The fatigue list says not to take drowsiness-causing medicine without distinguishing prescribed treatment or clinical supervision. Do not turn this into an instruction to stop or change medication; qualified review is needed.
Open source limitation (verify DE-FITNESS-STATISTICS): The hearing-record comparison and national alcohol-fatality percentage have no dated study or dataset in this passage. These numerical or comparative claims are excluded pending source and currency verification.
Open source limitation (verify DE-FITNESS-VISION-SCOPE): The passage states a screening passing criterion and a lower-acuity daylight restriction without a full restricted-license eligibility process. Preserve both source statements without inferring automatic eligibility or the full certification procedure.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.
